Last night there was another avalanche and the snow buried me to my neck. I almost lost hope, but then I remembered the Survival-Grade Foils Bundle in my pack. I lifted one of those beautiful, shimmering cards into the air and caught the setting winter’s sun at just the right angle. Within hours, friends from camp had dug me out of my most embarrassing predicament. Again.
